description: First-party Etsy demand and marketing evidence, reconciled locally.

novel_features.name: Listing action queue
novel_features.description: Rank listing-level research and marketing review actions from all four synchronized Etsy surfaces.

novel_features.name: Economics reconciliation
novel_features.description: Reconcile onsite spend, offsite fees, attributed revenue, and promotion observations without inventing net profit.

novel_features.name: Observed promotion lift
novel_features.description: Compare one promotion window with an equal-length prior window across promotion, onsite-ad, and offsite observations.

novel_features.name: Acquisition channel gap
novel_features.description: Find listings whose separately labeled onsite and offsite efficiency signals diverge.

novel_features.name: Research-quota allocation
novel_features.description: Prioritize scarce Marketplace Insights searches where stale demand evidence affects the most consequential listing decisions.

novel_features.name: Visibility-performance gap
novel_features.description: Compare explicit listing-keyword visibility observations with onsite and offsite performance without fabricating keyword revenue.

novel_features.name: Cross-surface anomalies
novel_features.description: Detect deterministic weekly outliers and coincident movements across all four synchronized surfaces.
